## What is wrong

## Evidence
Lines 471-475:

where `cmd_args` starts with `self.claude_flow_command = "npx claude-flow@alpha hooks"` (unsplit string).

## Inferred reason
Passing an unsplit string containing space characters as the executable argument in `create_subprocess_exec` will fail.

## v26.7.3 gate impact

## Required proof to promote

## Recommended next action
Split `self.claude_flow_command` string by spaces so it is passed as individual arguments.

## Do not do
